title: Addressing flip outside the dependence set
statement: Let $m$ be a natural number, let $J$ be a set of coordinates in a sign cube of dimension $m+2^m$, and let $g$ be a Boolean function on that cube that depends only on coordinates in $J$. For any input $x$ whose address-selected coordinate is not in $J$, flipping that selected coordinate leaves the value of $g$ unchanged.
